decisions.reason: Because this fin cooler is close to the firm's core offer, was publicly introduced on the website, and sits in a growing market where management can justify giving an incremental 2023 launch more time, it is likely to be retained.

As a close extension of the established condenser business with visible market commitment and likely engineering investment already made, management would tend to continue rather than admit an early reversal.

This product is also near the firm's existing condenser line and publicly launched, so under escalation-of-commitment logic management would usually keep it unless clear failure had emerged, which is not reported here.

The tube liner builds on the installed-base service business and supports lifecycle revenues, so despite somewhat narrower visibility than major equipment lines the firm is still more likely to keep it than withdraw it quickly.
A customized industrial air cooler fits especially well with the firm's solution-oriented strategy, service model, and engineering strengths, making withdrawal within a year relatively unlikely.

Although these repair inserts are a more specialized aftermarket item and thus somewhat easier to prune, they reinforce the firm's repair-and-upgrade position and management would still be inclined to keep them after launch.
